generate_clrs_train_dataset: run the script with --split_name train to generate a CLRS text training dataset in JSON format
generate_clrs_val_dataset: run the script with --split_name val to generate a CLRS text validation dataset in JSON format
generate_clrs_algo_dataset: create a TensorFlow dataset of CLRS samples for a given algorithm using generate_clrs_algo_dataset with a config
get_dataset_config: build a locked ConfigDict for a CLRS algorithm dataset using get_dataset_config with algo name, length, and seed
convert_tf_tensors_to_basic_types: convert TensorFlow tensor samples to basic Python types using _convert_to_basic_types with the CLRS_TF_TENSORS_CONVERTERS mapping
